items: The treehouse's dressing menus show every kind at once, stacked, with no tabs, floating over the room in a thin gold frame
The camera zooms in on what you're choosing: your face at the dressing table, your feet at the shoe rack
Your hat comes off at the dressing table so you can see your face and hair
Rows with nothing to choose yet stay hidden; the broom stand shows the classic broom until the Workshop
